original.target_description: Experiment 2; Interaction between determiner and ellipsis. Participant repeated-measures ANOVA on residual reading time. Restricted No-Ellipsis versus Small-Ellipsis comparison at the second word after V/Aux, identified by p. 36 locator.

n.exclusions: No participants excluded for accuracy; only correct comprehension trials; residual RTs beyond two SD removed (<5%).
n.quote: ACD resolution by Determiner and Ellipsis-Size (n = 48)

replication.target_description: Experiment 2; Interaction between determiner and ellipsis. Participant repeated-measures ANOVA on residual reading time.

n.exclusions: Eight of 80 participants excluded for US/native-English criteria; eight of 60 items excluded for <60% accuracy; correct trials only; HKV RT trimming.
n.quote: This resulted in omitting the data from 8 of the initial 80 participants.
